page_topic_one_liner: Subdomain vs subdirectory — SEO authority inheritance, link equity, and URL architecture comparison
differentiator_vs_generic: This is traditional site architecture SEO education, NOT GEO/LLM chat. Hero must be a side-by-side URL structure comparison showing authority flow differences — NOT an AI chat panel or generic domain registrar UI.
visual_anchors: HERO (~55% canvas): Split comparison panel — LEFT: subdomain layout blog.example.com on isolated island with broken/dim authority arrow from main example.com root; RIGHT: subdirectory layout example.com/blog with solid accent authority arrow flowing from root domain block into /blog folder
Secondary: URL bar mockups showing blog.example.com vs example.com/blog with accent underline on subdirectory path
Tertiary: small link-equity flow diagram — internal links within same domain (strong) vs cross-subdomain links (weaker, dashed)
anti_patterns: LLM chat panel as hero (this is URL architecture not GEO)
Generic website mockup without subdomain/subfolder contrast
DNS registrar or hosting control panel UI
